summary: Show the tickets selected by --ticket/--status in human dates output, and let a lower --rate-limit cap the per-source request rates.
reason: Publish review (PR #2291): the human dates table showed only the T1 summary, and dates/snapshot/waits built the source client with hardcoded rates that ignored --rate-limit.
validated_outcome: go vet and go test ./... pass; dates --ticket T1,T7 prints a Selected tickets table.
